sources.label: Official Levi's GB size chart (women's tops)

notes: Levi's publishes one chest/waist/hip value per letter size for women's tops, dresses and skirts. Jeans are sized by waist number (24-34) with their own waist/hip chart. Plus sizes 1X-3X each cover two numeric sizes.
audit: Old source URL is dead (404). Levi's GB gives no UK/US/EU dress-size mapping for letter sizes, so those are left blank rather than assumed; the plus-size numeric column is not labelled UK or US on the page. Old UK mapping (XS = UK 6-8 etc.) had no source.
